test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 1

questions.question: If 45% of a number exceeds 25% of it by 30, then the number is:
X, Y and Z invest ₹20,000, ₹30,000 and ₹50,000 respectively in a business. If the profit is ₹40,000, what is Y’s share?
The highest common factor (H.C.F.) and the least common multiple (L.C.M.) of two numbers are 3 and 234 respectively. If one of the numbers is 117, what is the other number?

Two trains are running in the same direction on parallel tracks. The length of train A is 150 m and its speed is 60 km/h, while the length of train B is 200 m and its speed is 40 km/h. Calculate the time taken by train A to overtake train B.

A invests ₹40,000 in a business. After 3 months, he adds ₹20,000. After another 3 months, he withdraws ₹10,000. B invests ₹50,000 for the whole year. If the total profit at the end of the year is ₹24,000, what is A’s share of the profit?
The average of the first 9 positive multiples of 8 is:
A closed cuboid has a total surface area of 256 m2 and its lateral surface area is 145 m2. What is the area of its base?
A solid metal sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and reshaped into a cone having a base radius of 8 cm. Find the height of the cone.
Person A can complete a piece of work in 6 days, while Person B can complete the same work in 9 days. If both A and B start working together, how long (in days) will they take to complete the work?
A bottle of a soft drink costs ₹45. A container containing 20 bottles of the same soft drink costs ₹720. What is the effective discount (in %) per bottle when purchased in the container?
What sum (in ₹) will amount to ₹7,560 in 5 years at 5% per annum simple interest?
Mahesh deposited a certain sum of money at 20% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. At the end of 2 years, Mahesh received a total amount of ₹81,468. What was the sum deposited by Mahesh?
The average of 13 numbers is 8. If each number is multiplied by 6, then what will the new average be:
Forty-eight men can dig a trench in 14 days. In how many days will 28 men dig the same trench?
If 12 : y :: y : 75, find the positive value of y.

A can complete a piece of work alone in 10 days, and B can complete the same work alone in 15 days. If they work on alternate days (i.e., A works on odd days and B works on even days), in how many days will the work be completed?

One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 92 km/hr, the next one-third at 87 km/hr, and the remaining one-third at 4 km/hr. What is the average speed (in km/hr) for the entire journey? (Round your answer to the nearest integer.)
The average price of three items of furniture is ₹16,440. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, then the price of the costliest item (in ₹) is:
A man buys a car for ₹3,08,000 and spends ₹24,000 on its repairs. What should be its selling price (in ₹) if he wants to earn a 9% profit?
If an 8-digit number 70814p02 is divisible by 6, then the minimum value of p is:
